batches.purpose: Port the smallest Flatpak substrate after Podman without accepting donor /usr, /lib, /bin, /etc, or /var paths as AUZiX root authority.

packages.notes: Sandbox helper. First proof must run /Programs/Bubblewrap/current/Commands/bwrap --version without requiring /usr/bin/bwrap.
Content-addressed backing store lives under /System/State/ostree; commands project through /Programs/OSTree/current/Commands.
Portal/dbus boundary helper. Keep runtime sockets under /run and AUZiX service state, not donor /var paths.
Provides gpg/gpgconf/gpg-agent/gpgsm/gpgv through /Programs/GnuPG/current/Commands so Flatpak/GPGME can verify signed remote summaries without donor /usr/bin paths.

System installation state belongs under /System/State/flatpak and settings under /System/Settings/flatpak. Remote metadata reads must validate Flathub TLS and GPGME/GnuPG engine setup before an app is considered pullable. No app is considered integrated until it has a /Programs/<App>/current adapter.

batches.purpose: Expose Flatpak applications as normal AUZiX programs without making root-level compatibility links part of the base image.

packages.notes: Terminal editor proof. Provides /Programs/Micro/current/Commands/micro and exported desktop metadata.
Flatpak app-browser proof. CLI launch works; full app-store behavior still wants desktop portal/system-helper/session services.
Music-player proof. Confirms AUZiX can expose heavier GUI apps while audio/session validation remains a desktop lane.
Photo-manager proof. Flathub payload launches on VM135 after user Flatpak state ownership repair; document portal still needs the FUSE/kernel-module fix.
Modern code-editor proof for dev workstation testing. Zed payload is Flathub-managed under /System/State/flatpak; AUZiX owns the /Programs/Zed launcher and desktop entry.
Amiga emulator proof for the AUZiX desktop demo lane. Payload is Flathub-managed; AUZiX owns /Programs/FSUAE launchers, menu metadata, and user-facing integration.
Windows compatibility proof for the workstation lane. Bottles depends heavily on Flatpak portals/session state and should validate after Flatpak system-helper/user install issues are resolved.
Control-panel lane. Package GNOME Settings/control-center dependencies as desktop/session infrastructure, not as a simple Flatpak shortcut.
